Combat Assist integrates the Dice Buttons with a combat status/control widget to speed game play whilst conforming to online conventions
See Help...Releases Notes for more information.

VASSAL.build.module.map.MassKeyCommand.name: Confirm & Roll
VASSAL.build.module.map.MassKeyCommand.reportFormat:
{PlayerSide=="Solitaire" ? Alert("Use Solo mode to take advantage of Combat Assist.") : PlayerSide!="" ? gblPhase==3 && (gblDiceProposed>-1 || gblCombatPhase>2) && ( gblDiceSide==PlayerSide || gblSolo==true) ? "" : Alert("The attacking player may use this shortcut as an alternative to clicking on the Combat
Assist icon when a dice roll is offered.
Either player may use the equivalent Combat Assist right-click option to roll the dice.

Note: At the start of combat, the number of dice must first be set using the dice buttons.") : Alert("Observers welcome but please do not interfere with the game.")}
VASSAL.build.module.map.MassKeyCommand.tooltip: Attacking player rolls offered dice or Defending player agrees proposed dice

VASSAL.build.module.map.MassKeyCommand.name: Apply Hits
VASSAL.build.module.map.MassKeyCommand.reportFormat:
{PlayerSide=="Solitaire" ? Alert("Use Solo mode to take advantage of Combat Assist.") : PlayerSide!="" ? gblPhase==3 && (gblDiceProposed>-1 || gblCombatPhase>2) && ( gblDiceSide!=PlayerSide || gblSolo==true) ? "" : Alert("The defending player may use this shortcut as an alternative to clicking on the Combat
Assist icon when Hits are displayed.
Either player may use the equivalent Combat Assist right-click option.") : Alert("Observers welcome but please do not interfere with the game.")}
VASSAL.build.module.map.MassKeyCommand.tooltip: Defending player accepts and applies the hits displayed on the Combat Assist icon

{(gblModuleSetup!=true ? "

*** Welcome to the Commands & Colors: Napoleonics Vassal module, Lock-Down Edition (Version " + ModuleVersion + ") ***

See Help...Release Notes for an introduction to the module." + (prefNoWelcome!=true || ModuleVersion.contains("a") ? Alert("Commands & Colors: Napoleonics, LockDown Edition Version " + ModuleVersion + "

"+(ModuleVersion.contains("a") ?"This version has been released for testing and may have been superseded.
If in doubt, check the Vassal Module library or Help...Release Notes.

":"")+"

Warning: Both players must use compatible versions of the module.
This version is not compatible with any earlier release.

I hope you enjoy the enhancements.
Please send queries or feedback to CCNLDE@gmail.com

"+(ModuleVersion.contains("a")?"":"This welcome message can be disabled from Preferences, Game Options tab.

")+"Mark B."):"") :"") + (prefDeckValue!="" ? "

Remain offline and in the <observer> role whilst editing the scenario.

Clear the Maintenance checkbox then re-open the scenario to resume normal play.") }

Conversion required!
V3 scenarios require update to use with this module (prior versions are not supported). All pre-set scenarios have been converted.
To convert V3 scenario files, take the following steps:

1. From the Command Bar, perform Tools...Refresh Counters. Important: Check all Refresh Counters options except for \"Test Mode\".
2. If the scenario has not already been updated, a prompt will be displayed giving further instructions.

Warning: Converted scenarios are not compatible with any earlier release of the module.

For assistance with conversion, please contact CCNLDE@gmail.com

Mark B."):"" }
